title: Implementer report
description: What the implementer returns, as a single fenced JSON block. Root validates it with scripts/check_return.py before acting on it: a malformed return earns exactly one corrective retry, which does not consume an implementation attempt because nothing was implemented differently.

tests.description: Both phases are required when status is DONE. check_return.py enforces that: a DONE report whose red counts are absent is rejected, because a test written after the implementation proves the code runs, not that the test can fail.

evidence.description: Verbatim command output excerpts backing the counts above.

notes.description: Anything the brief did not cover, ambiguity found, or work deliberately left undone. Empty string when there is none.

phase.description: Null only for a report that is not DONE. A DONE report needs both phases observed.

reused.description: True when these counts carry over from an earlier run at an unchanged HEAD rather than being observed now. Reuse is legitimate and cheap; unlabelled reuse is a false claim about this run.
